name: Kansas
status_why: The election-night page answers scripts with a Cloudflare refusal. Official precinct workbooks come after the State Board of Canvassers.
system: Secretary of State's own static election-night pages (ent.sos.ks.gov, 'Unofficial Kansas Election Results', meta refresh every 5 s) behind Cloudflare; official results later as PDF and precinct workbooks on sos.ks.gov (CloudFront).

results_page.label: Kansas Secretary of State: unofficial election night results
results_page.confirmed: 2026-10-10: not asked: ent.sos.ks.gov is on the never list (it refuses scripts), so no program asks it; the page is for readers' own browsers, as the scout found it (2026-10-09)

feeds.address: https://ent.sos.ks.gov/kssos_ent.html and pages beside it (older years had kssos.org/ent/<year><type>/live/<county>.html)
feeds.updates: page refreshes every 5 seconds; goes live at 5 p.m. on election day, results after the 7 p.m. poll close
feeds.note: HTTP 403 from Cloudflare on 2026-10-09, although the body was the real page (title 'Unofficial Kansas Election Results', keywords for the 2026 primary, meta ROBOTS NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW). A 403 is a refusal: do not get around it.

feeds.address: https://sos.ks.gov/elections/26elec/2026-General-Election-<Office>-Precinct-Level-Results.xlsx (pattern of the 2024 and 2026 primary files, for example 26elec/2026-Primary-Election-United-States-Senate-Precinct-Level-Results.xlsx); official vote totals PDF 26elec/2026-Primary-Election-Official-Vote-Totals.pdf
feeds.updates: once, after the State Board of Canvassers certifies (Dec 2 in 2024)
feeds.note: Results page HTTP 200 (CloudFront) on 2026-10-09. Format is xlsx (recorded as csv-like tables).

races_in_feed: judges (Court of Appeals, district and magistrate retention)
local: Yes. Johnson County Election Office (jocoelection.org), Sedgwick County (sedgwick.gov elections), Wyandotte/KCK (wycokck.org), Shawnee (snco.us/election). None of these were requested.
how_counted: Counties report to the Secretary of State's election-night page from 7 p.m.; official results follow the State Board of Canvassers.
vote_types: Not split in the official workbooks seen. The election-night page was not readable.

certify.body: the Kansas State Board of Canvassers
certify.rule: Meets no later than December 1 (Kan. Stat. 25-3206).
certify.local_rule: County abstracts by the second Tuesday after the election (Kan. Stat. 25-3203).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

terms: The results page says unofficial and precinct results 'are available upon request' from the Elections Division.
scout_blocked: ent.sos.ks.gov answers scripts with 403 (Cloudflare). The candidate list page (elections_upcoming_candidate.aspx) also answers 403 (CloudFront), as recorded in ballot/lists/ks.py.
scout_plan: No live feed a script may read. Options: (1) John saves the election-night page from his browser every so often into a watched folder, as he does for Minnesota; (2) show Kansas through the news feed and the AP-free official sources only after canvass, using the precinct workbooks for the map. County sites (Johnson, Sedgwick) may publish readable election-night files; check them once each before November. Ask John which he prefers.
notes: The official results page https://sos.ks.gov/elections/election-results.html answered one request on 2026-10-10 (200).
2026-10-10 (N12): confirmed as a link state; certified results source recorded under certified_results.
